title: A REST operation is named <alias>_<METHOD>; a provider operation's base URL is the REST Target Location then /<service alias>/
statement: Adding a REST operation from a service in PIA appends _<METHOD> to the name typed and keeps the typed name as IB_ALIASNAME. A provider operation's IB_RESTBASE_URL is Service Configuration's REST Target Location followed by /<service alias>/ (two slashes when the service has no alias); a consumer operation's is what is entered.

observations.observation: A provider GET operation typed with a name was saved as name_GET with IB_ALIASNAME the typed name and IB_RESTBASE_URL equal to IB_RESTTGTLOC followed by two slashes (service without alias); every delivered provider operation reached at the local target location follows the same pattern.
